meta.title: Game Hub – Mini game portal
meta.description: Play free mini games, sign in with your MetaMask wallet and climb the leaderboard.

home.heroSubtitle: Connect your MetaMask wallet and start playing – your scores are saved and ranked against other players.
home.dbError: Cannot connect to the database – make sure Docker is running (npm run db:up).
home.noGames: No games in this category yet.

auth.required: Please connect your wallet to view this page.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to the admin area.

errors.NO_WALLET: MetaMask was not found in this browser.
errors.USER_REJECTED: You rejected the request in MetaMask.
errors.REQUEST_PENDING: MetaMask already has a pending request – open the MetaMask extension.
errors.NONCE_INVALID: Your sign-in session expired, please try again.
errors.INVALID_MESSAGE: The sign-in message is invalid or expired.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts, please wait a moment.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong, please try again.

game.loginToSave: You're playing as a guest – connect your wallet to save scores and join the leaderboard.
game.unavailable: This game is under maintenance, please come back later.
game.notSaved: You scored {score}. Connect your wallet to save it next time!

errors.PLAY_TOO_SHORT: Score not recorded: the round was too short (below the game's minimum play time).
errors.SCORE_INVALID: Score not recorded: the score is outside the allowed range.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Score not recorded: the round was open for too long.
errors.SESSION_ENDED: This round's score was already submitted.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Round not found, please start a new game.
errors.LEADERBOARD_NOT_FOUND: The game sent a score to a leaderboard that doesn't exist.
errors.GAME_UNAVAILABLE: The game is under maintenance, the score was not saved.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You're submitting too fast, try again in a few minutes.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired, please connect your wallet again.
errors.GUEST_NOT_ALLOWED: Connect your wallet to save scores.
errors.UNKNOWN: Couldn't save your score, please try again.
errors.SCORE_TOO_FAST: Score not recorded: points were earned unusually fast for the time played.
errors.SESSION_NOT_STARTED: Score not recorded: the round couldn't be started on the server (try reloading the page).

game.notSavedLateLogin: You scored {score}, but this round started before you connected your wallet, so it wasn't saved. Your next round will count!

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No scores yet – be the first!
leaderboard.loginHint: Connect your wallet to appear on the leaderboard.

profile.title: My profile
profile.loginRequired: Connect your wallet to view your profile.
profile.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, underscore (uppercase is converted). Empty = use wallet address.
profile.avatarHint: Paste an image link starting with https://

errors.invalid: Invalid details: the name may be reserved (admin, system…) or the avatar is not an https:// link.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong, please try again.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Manage games, review versions and set the live version.
admin.storageHint: Copy the build into public/uploads/<build folder>/ (with index.html) first, then add and approve the version. Direct upload comes in Phase 10.
admin.name: Name
admin.createHint: New games start as Draft. Add a version → approve → make live → set status to Published.

errors.NO_APPROVED_VERSION: Approve a version and make it live before publishing.
errors.VERSION_IN_USE: You can't reject the live version.
errors.CONFLICT: Duplicate data (slug or version name already exists).

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page or game you're looking for doesn't exist or was removed.
